blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Bukidnon’s agricultural hub remains resilient even in the shadow of a developing Super El Niño. Last Tuesday, tables overflowed with freshly harvested fruits, crisp vegetables, root crops, and other local delicacies at the city government multi-purpose covered court. The vibrant display launched Valencia City’s 16th Farmers’ Month Celebration, bringing together hundreds of farmers, fisherfolk, Irrigators Associations, Rural Improvement Club (RIC) members, and 4-H Club youth. Despite mounting climate threats, the kick-off showcased an abundant harvest, a testament to the hard work of those who continue to safeguard the region’s food supply.
